name: Zeomova
address_source: Google Business Profile lists no street address (service-area business, confirmed via gmaps_detail.js: address field empty). Coordinates place it near West Palm Beach, FL; reviews and category confirm the operating area is West Palm Beach and South Florida. Per the adapted-variant rule, the map/address section was omitted from the site and replaced with a real photo of the fleet.
phone_source: Google Business Profile (business.google.com listing 'Zeomova', category Moving and storage service), matches the phone number printed on the branded truck and on the crew's polo shirt in Google Photos.
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows 'Add website' (no website field set), confirmed live via node scripts/gmaps_detail.js. WebSearch '"Zeomova" moving West Palm Beach website instagram facebook' returned no matching business at all (only unrelated national movers). curl checks on zeomovamoving.com, zeomova-moving.com and zeomovaservices.com returned 502/unreachable through the proxy (no live site); zeomova.com returned no real HTTP response either (connect failure), consistent with no registered working site. No Wix/Squarespace/GoDaddy Sites/WordPress presence found anywhere.

social_media.evidence: WebSearch for Zeomova + West Palm Beach + instagram/facebook returned zero matches for this business. No link to any social profile on the Google Business Profile. Not used anywhere on the site.

email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field), WebSearch for an official site or social profile (none found, see has_own_site_evidence), no linktree/bio to follow since there is no Instagram/Facebook profile. Phone (call or text) is the only real public contact channel for this business, consistent with FORGE-BRIEF's note that home-service/moving trades rarely publish email.

google_business.hours: Open 24 hours, every day (per live Google Business Profile status, re-verified with gmaps_detail.js)
google_business.about_text_source: GBP 'From the owner' note (Jul 6, 2026): 'Zeomova moving services at city furniture' - several reviews independently confirm the crew has handled deliveries from City Furniture / City Home, consistent with a crew that also does white-glove furniture delivery, not only full household moves.

services_source: No prices or a published service menu anywhere (no own site, no booking platform). Service categories below are derived directly from the GBP category ('Moving and storage service'), the truck signage ('LOCAL & LONG DISTANCE'), and real, repeated mentions in verbatim Google reviews (furniture wrapping/protection, single heavy-item moves, full household moves, special furniture deliveries). No price list exists anywhere: the site uses 'quoted by phone' framing throughout, per the adapted-variant rule (no invented prices).

services.local_moves: Apartments, condos and houses across West Palm Beach and South Florida, full wrap and protection for every piece.
services.long_distance: Moves beyond South Florida, planned and loaded the same careful way.
services.full_household: Whole-home moves, room to room, floor to floor or city to city, handled as one job.
services.single_items_and_furniture: One heavy or awkward piece, or a special furniture delivery (reviews mention deliveries from City Furniture / City Home), wrapped and carried with the same care as a full move.

pricing_note: No prices published anywhere. Site uses 'Quoted by phone' / free phone quote framing only, never a price list or 'starting at $X'.

brand_vibe: Navy blue / steel blue, light background. Derived directly from the real truck decal and crew polo shirt branding (navy blue 'Zeomova' wordmark and circular logo, 'Move Confidently' tagline) visible in Google Photos. Built from templates/light-v2 (EN-default skeleton), palette swapped from the original lash-pink tones to navy/steel-blue throughout (CSS custom properties + all rgba/hex brand tones), Merktop badge left untouched/gold per spec.
adapted_variant_notes: No booking platform (no Booksy/Square/etc): all 'book' CTAs replaced with tel:+15618129646 (call) and sms:+15618129646 (text). No published address: location/map section replaced with a real fleet photo and 'service area' copy instead of an embedded Google Map, per FORGE-BRIEF 0.b. No published prices: every service card uses 'Quoted by phone' instead of a $ amount. No Instagram/Facebook: all social CTAs/buttons replaced with call/text equivalents, nothing invented.
